comment.body_excerpt: ## Investigation: `CURRENT_SOURCE_REPLY_ACTION_NAMES` explicitly excludes `thread-reply`; thread-placement validation is the missing piece ... ing via `thread-reply` + `NO_REPLY` can draw the no-visible-reply fallback despite having delivered to the current conversation's thread.

reasons: GitHub deterministic signal indicates the comment was minimized as spam.
Audit policy treats already-minimized spam or abuse as high-signal spam regardless of technical-looking text.
